high_level_description: This image is a satellite photograph of the Isfahan nuclear facility, dated June 14, 2025. The photograph is labeled with "Damaged structures" indicating areas that have been affected by some form of damage or strike. The scale on the image shows that one unit represents 500 feet. The text at the top of the image states: "Damage at the Isfahan nuclear facility." It mentions that CNN obtained satellite imagery from Maxar Technologies, which showed that several areas of the facility were damaged in the strikes.
